money.ref: Original CFA-franc cases and computed records; IMF money/inflation explanations; Federal Reserve price-level education; Bank of England bank-money mechanism; OpenStax bank balance-sheet and stylised multiplier; official BEAC institutional role
money.checked: Consulted 2026-10-24. No real prices, account details, national totals, policy rates, reserve fractions, budgets or tax procedures are asserted. BEAC institutional missions and member scope checked against its official pages; no officeholders or current parameter is needed. OpenStax multiplier is explicitly a stylised geometric model; Bank of England mechanism explains why it is not a mechanical prediction of modern lending. No foreign institution’s current rules are transferred to Cameroon.
